entry.title: DIOL Pilot 1 Flights: Coast to SOV for Offshore Logistics by BVLOS Drone Operation | Fraunhofer IFAM

media:group.media:title: DIOL Pilot 1 Flights: Coast to SOV for Offshore Logistics by BVLOS Drone Operation | Fraunhofer IFAM
media:group.media:description:
More than 250 km across the open North Sea, with a cargo delivery along the way.
As part of the Interreg North Sea DIOL project, a drone flew from the German mainland to a operation and maintenance vessel offshore, safely delivered its cargo and returned to shore.
The successful mission shows the potential of drone-based delivery to significantly reduce transportation times for critical spare parts and make offshore wind maintenance faster and more efficient. _____________ Website www.ifam.fraunhofer.de

entry.title: Welcome to the Future: Vision Woman ‪@FraunhoferIFAM‬

media:group.media:title: Welcome to the Future: Vision Woman ‪@FraunhoferIFAM‬
media:group.media:description:
Welcome to the future—and it has a name: Vision Woman.
She’s fast. She’s smart. She’s brave. And she shows what innovation looks like today: surprising, humorous, and rooted in real life.
In this AI-powered short film, our Fraunhofer IFAM superheroine Vision Woman takes you along on her 601st mission—a journey through technologies that are changing our world. Futuristic scenes, striking visuals, and a touch of whimsy guide you through topics like 3D printing, smart materials, sustainable solutions, and high-tech research.
But Vision Woman is more than just a heroine: She’s also a mother, a partner, and a master of everyday life. When the “cookie alarm” goes off at home, she quickly sends 3D-printed cookies via drone—a charming symbol of how technology can make our lives easier, more colorful, and more creative.
Innovation meets everyday life. The future meets humor. Research meets the heart.
Because: #IFAMdrivesInnovation

entry.title: HYTANK: Developing CFRP LH₂ Tanks for Zero-Emission Flight

media:group.media:title: HYTANK: Developing CFRP LH₂ Tanks for Zero-Emission Flight
media:group.media:description:
In the HYTANK project, Fraunhofer IFAM is working on CFRP-based LH₂ tanks and the required manufacturing processes. The focus lies on coating, joining, and assembly processes, as well as tailored surface preparation and barrier coatings.
In this video:
- Surface pre-treatment using atmospheric pressure plasma, laser, and vacuum UV-light - Application of barrier coatings for cryogenic hydrogen tanks
The project highlights Fraunhofer IFAM’s expertise in processing and coating large-scale components, developing innovative process chains, and implementing automated manufacturing solutions for aerospace applications. _____________ Website www.ifam.fraunhofer.de

entry.title: HYTANK: Entwicklung von CFK LH₂ Tanks für emissionsfreies Fliegen

media:group.media:title: HYTANK: Entwicklung von CFK LH₂ Tanks für emissionsfreies Fliegen
media:group.media:description:
Im Projekt HYTANK entwickelt das Fraunhofer IFAM CFK-basierte LH₂-Tanks und die dafür notwendigen Fertigungsprozesse. Der Fokus liegt auf Beschichtungs-, Füge- und Montageprozessen sowie auf angepassten Oberflächenvorbehandlungen und Barriereschichten.
Im Video zu sehen: • Oberflächenvorbehandlung mit Atmosphärendruckplasma, Laser und Vakuum-UV-Licht • Applikation von Barriereschichten für kryogene Wasserstofftanks
Das Projekt zeigt die Kompetenzen des Fraunhofer IFAM in der Bearbeitung und Beschichtung von Großbauteilen, der Entwicklung innovativer Prozessketten sowie der Umsetzung automatisierter Fertigungslösungen für die Luftfahrt. _____________ Website www.ifam.fraunhofer.de

media:group.media:description:
In this video, you will discover insights from the “Quartier für Quartier” ("Neighborhood by Neighborhood") project, which investigates the transformation of heating systems through the lens of local communities. Learn how the planned phase-out of natural gas over the next 20 years, in line with climate targets, poses significant challenges regarding existing gas distribution networks. entry.title: Fraunhofer IFAM: Annual Report 2024/2025 | Business Unit Medical Technologies | Project "Osteofunk"

media:group.media:title: Fraunhofer IFAM: Annual Report 2024/2025 | Business Unit Medical Technologies | Project "Osteofunk"
media:group.media:description:
In this video, we delve into our “Osteofunk” project, which investigates the potential of the polymer material PEEK in reconstructive surgery. Discover how PEEK, with its bone-like mechanical properties, offers advantages over traditional titanium implants, including lightweight flexibility and minimal interference with X-rays. We also address the challenges of PEEK's hydrophobic nature and explore innovative techniques to enhance its surface for better biological compatibility, aiming to improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare strain. _____________ Website www.ifam.fraunhofer.de
